title: Horizon and Monsoon
author: Kestrel Vasquez
blurb: Quentin Ashgrove, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
